summary_en: Obayashi Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 20 million shares (2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 30 billion yen via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 to January 29, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Concerning the Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Obayashi Corporation's Board of Directors resolved on November 13, 2026 to acquire up to 20 million shares of its own common stock for a maximum of 30 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 to January 29, 2027. The acquisition represents 2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. All acquired shares are scheduled to be cancelled.

The company cited multiple reasons for the acquisition, including the implementation of growth strategies to achieve sustained profit growth and the pursuit of capital-efficient management. The company forecasts achieving its target of 10% return on equity (ROE) in fiscal year 2026 (year ending March 31, 2027). This acquisition represents the second tranche of a 100 billion yen share buyback program announced in February 2025; the company completed 70 billion yen of acquisitions and cancellations by January 2026 and now proceeds with the remaining 30 billion yen.

The decision reflects the company's comprehensive assessment of group performance, investment plans, steady reduction of policy-held stocks in line with targets, and stable financial position. The company indicated that its future shareholder return policy is still under review and will be presented as part of its capital allocation strategy in the next medium-term management plan.
